blocks.translation:
△ Caution To customers who purchased this product: Be sure to read this Instruction Manual.
● This product is for Ages 15+. Do not give it to children under the indicated age. Be careful to prevent accidental ingestion of batteries (sold separately), the battery cover, screws, etc. There are pointed and sharp parts, so take care when handling and storing. Unexpected injury may occur.
● Do not use near the ear. Improper use may damage hearing. This product contains electronic components. If you use a pacemaker, keep this product away from your body.
● Do not stare at the flashing LED light; this may cause discomfort or other symptoms.
● The included Beast Battery is a toy. Do not use it for any purpose other than its intended toy use, as this may lead to unexpected accidents.
<<Improper use of batteries may cause overheating, rupture, or leakage. Observe the following:>>
Do not use secondary batteries (rechargeable batteries). ● Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries. Insert batteries with the correct polarity (+ and -).
● After playing, always turn the switch off and remove the batteries. Leaving batteries installed may cause leakage and is dangerous. Do not short-circuit, charge, disassemble, heat, or place batteries into fire.
● If battery fluid gets into the eyes, rinse immediately with plenty of water and consult a doctor. If it gets on the skin or clothing, wash with water.
● When disposing, follow your local municipality's waste disposal instructions.

blocks.translation:
<Precautions for Use> ● This product is precision-made. Applying excessive force or dropping it may cause damage. This product contains precision electronic parts; do not drop it, get it wet, soil it, or disassemble it. Also avoid using or storing it in places of extremely high or low temperature.
● Dispose of plastic packing material immediately after opening. Because this product has painted surfaces, avoid contact with other items (resin products, furniture, sofas) during storage to prevent color transfer.
● Do not forcibly pull or bend movable parts or attachment points in unnatural directions. Some vocal sounds may have different intonation or be hard to hear due to the product's characteristics; please understand this.
● Do not insert anything other than compatible Beast Batteries into the Gaburevolver -MEMORIAL EDITION-. Doing so may cause malfunction or damage.
● Do not insert the included Beast Battery into products other than those it is compatible with; doing so may cause malfunction or damage.
